name: @appwithai/eml-cli
description: Build applications from an EML (.mmd) model describing an ERD, business rules, and workflows.
_comment:tooling: No devDependencies and no lockfile here on purpose. This directory is part of common/, not a separately installed package: its type-check is common/'s `bun run type-check` (tsconfig.language.json includes language/**) and its lint is `bun run lint:language`. The three devDependencies that used to sit here — typescript 5.6.3, @types/node 22 and bun-types — were never installed by anything: `bun run typecheck` here resolved tsc and its types out of common/node_modules, so the pins were decoration that disagreed with the versions actually used (typescript ^7.0.2, @types/bun). bun-types was doubly dead: @types/bun already depends on it.
